description.value: Chartreuse Moose Cappuccino Bar & Bistro is a cafe in BC's Cariboo/Chilcotin region that roasts all of its coffee in-house. It offers a full menu of food, beverages, baked goods, and desserts available for in-store dining or curbside pickup, with online ordering via the website or a dedicated mobile app. For a touring cyclist passing through a sparsely serviced stretch of central BC interior, it stands out as a well-equipped stop with free Wi-Fi.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active cappuccino bar and bistro offering in-store and curbside pickup, with free Wi-Fi explicitly stated and corroborated by the OSM internet_access=wlan tag. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information appeared in either the website content or OSM tags. Phone number 250-395-4644 was found on the website but is absent from OSM; no address was available in either source.
concerns: No address present in OSM or visible on the website content; physical location cannot be verified.
Phone number 250-395-4644 found on website but absent from OSM record — OSM should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, in-house-roasting cafe with food, baked goods, curbside pickup, and free Wi-Fi in a remote stretch of the Cariboo/Chilcotin — a clear and useful stop for touring cyclists.
